_comment: One list of report types for the patient app (Send report) and the clinical screens. short = shown everywhere; full and why = shown only on hover. route 'external' = one value, reviewed on the split screen (external_type is the stored test type); route 'lab' = a lab report whose values the team enters. Wording requires clinician sign-off.

prescription.why: Shows the medicines you take now.

tests.why: Average blood sugar over the last 2–3 months.
Blood sugar after at least 8 hours without food.
Blood sugar 2 hours after a meal.
How the body handles sugar after a glucose drink.

tests.full: Kidney function test (creatinine, eGFR, urine albumin)
tests.why: Diabetes can harm the kidneys; this finds it early.
Checks heart risk, which diabetes raises.
Finds early eye and nerve damage from diabetes.
Ketones warn of very high sugar (risk of diabetic ketoacidosis).
Any other test report. Write its name.
